_about: Pins for the P2-13 suite-vs-suite comparison ONLY. The official suite is compared at CURRENT MAIN (deliberately newer than the signal-pin in conformance/SOURCES.lock.json: a fair head-to-head must face the official suite at its best, including its newest fixes). Regenerate deliberately with fetch_official.sh --repin and re-run the comparison; results/*.md is only valid for the SHAs it records in its own meta block.

official_conformance_suite.note: 9 commits ahead of the SOURCES.lock signal pin f78fe9f1 at comparison time — #73/#76/#77/#78/#79 authored by vishkaty (incl. the webhook_structure_test module and the grand-total formula verification), #74/#75 by Xiaolong Zhang, #80/#81 by FanouZeng-TT (authorship verified in the repo's git log at this SHA). 78 test methods.

official_python_sdk_sibling.resolve_full_sha_note: fetch_official.sh checks out THIS SHA — reproduction must not float. The verdict-defining official miss (ERR-029) exists because of a python-sdk model bug we intend to fix upstream; an unpinned sdk would silently flip that verdict the day the fix merges. --repin moves both pins together.
official_python_sdk_sibling.why: the official suite's pyproject takes ucp-sdk as an editable PATH dep from ../python-sdk; current-main tests import modules (reverse_domain_name, error_response) that exist only past the 0.3.0 tag, so this pin is a main SHA (0.4.4), chosen at re-pin time and frozen here for reproduction.

golden: the flower reference server pinned by conformance/SOURCES.lock.json reference_sample_server — the SAME golden our own CI kill-tests run against; boot with conformance/ci/serve_golden.sh.
